g.text: World ID Live Check (World ID 4.0) - Cognito Custom Auth Sequence
Strict order. An empty session (no password),
a failed step, or any other sequence fails.
mode, app_id, rp_id, environment, signed rp_context,
mode, nonce, + unique and action (enroll) or session_id (prove)
user scans QR, completes Live Check
Require environment and session_id to match
A failed condition rejects the answer:
account already enrolled, person already enrolled,
or a replayed proof. Any error fails closed.
